name: Church Growth
overview: Scripture reveals that church growth is a divine work grounded in steadfast faithfulness to apostolic teaching, fellowship, prayer, and worship, as seen in Acts 2:42 and 2:47 where the Lord adds those who are saved to the church daily. The church, built on the foundation of Christ as the unshakable rock (Matthew 16:18), grows not by human effort alone but through Christ drawing people to Himself (John 12:32). This growth brings fear of the Lord, edification, and multiplication of believers who walk in reverence and are comforted by the Holy Spirit (Acts 9:31), resulting in a community that praises God and gains favor with others (Psalms 40:3; Acts 2:47).
